new.note: Beef roasted medium-rare, green peppercorn pan sauce, potato gratin and asparagus.
new.how: Beef eye fillet roasted to medium-rare with a green peppercorn pan sauce, potato gratin and asparagus. Season a 1kg beef eye fillet, sear all over in a hot pan and roast at 200C for 20 to 25 minutes for medium-rare. Rest 10 minutes. Slice 1kg potatoes thinly, layer in a buttered dish with 300ml cream, garlic and salt and bake at 180C for 60 minutes. Deglaze the beef pan with 300ml beef stock and 1 tbsp crushed green peppercorns, reduce by half, then whisk in 20g butter. Serve with steamed asparagus.

r2.make_ahead: Gratin can bake an hour ahead and sit covered

steps.text: Slice the potatoes thinly, layer in a buttered dish with the cream, garlic and salt, and bake at 180C.
Season the beef, sear it all over in a hot pan and roast at 200C for medium-rare.
Rest the beef.
Deglaze the pan with the stock and peppercorns, reduce by half, then whisk in the butter.
Steam the asparagus and slice the beef to serve.

new.note: Ginger beer, fresh lime and mint over crushed ice, cold enough for courtside.
new.how: Spicy ginger beer and fresh lime over crushed ice in plastic cups, with a mint sprig standing in for the love fern. Chill 4 tall plastic cups or glasses. Squeeze a quarter of a lime into each and fill with crushed ice. Top with 300ml cold ginger beer, drop a lime wedge and a mint sprig in each and serve straight away.

r2.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours, keep the ginger beer cold

steps.text: Chill 4 tall cups or glasses.
Squeeze a quarter of a lime into each and fill with crushed ice.
Top with the ginger beer, drop in a lime wedge and mint sprig and serve straight away.

new.note: Penne in a rosy tomato, cream and chilli sauce with parmesan, prom night carbs.
new.how: Penne in a rosy sauce of tomato, cream, garlic and chilli, finished with parmesan and basil. Soften 3 crushed garlic cloves and a pinch of chilli flakes in 2 tbsp olive oil. Add a 400g can of crushed tomatoes and 1 tbsp tomato paste and simmer 10 minutes. Stir in 200ml cream until rosy. Toss with 500g cooked penne, then finish with grated parmesan and torn basil.

r2.make_ahead: Sauce up to a day ahead, chilled

steps.text: Soften the garlic and chilli in the oil.
Add the tomatoes and tomato paste and simmer.
Stir in the cream until rosy.
Cook the penne in salted water until al dente and drain.
Toss the penne through the sauce and finish with parmesan and torn basil.

new.note: Cola over ice with cherry syrup and a lemon twist, from the gas station fridge.
new.how: Ice-cold cola poured over ice with a splash of cherry syrup and a lemon twist, the way a gas station fountain does it. Chill 4 tall glasses. Put 2 tsp cherry syrup in each, fill with ice and top with 300ml cold cola. Stir once, twist a strip of lemon peel over the top and drop it in.

r2.make_ahead: Cut the lemon twists up to a day ahead; pour to order

steps.text: Chill 4 tall glasses.
Put the cherry syrup in each glass, fill with ice and top with cola.
Stir once and twist a strip of lemon peel over each.

new.note: Beef chuck stewed with stock, onions and carrots over buttery mash.
new.how: Beef chuck browned and simmered 3 hours with onion, carrots and beef stock until tender, served over buttery mash. Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Soften 2 onions and 3 carrots, add 1 tbsp tomato paste, then the beef back with 750ml beef stock and a bay leaf. Simmer for 3 hours until tender. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with plenty of butter, then spoon the stew on top.

r2.make_ahead: Stew keeps 3 days chilled and is better the next day

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches.
Soften the onions and carrots, stir in the tomato paste, return the beef with the stock and bay leaf and simmer until tender.
Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter.
Spoon the stew over the mash.

veg.make_ahead: Braise the stew up to 2 days ahead and reheat gently; boil and mash the potatoes fresh

steps.text: Dice the onions and carrots.
Brown the mushrooms in batches in the oil.
Soften the onions and carrots, return the mushrooms with the stock, vinegar and lentils and simmer until thick.
Boil the potatoes and mash with plenty of butter.
Spoon the stew over the mash.

new.veg: Portobello mushrooms and lentils stewed with stock, onions and carrots over mash.

old: Premiere night roast beef with popovers

new.n: Premiere night roast beef with popovers
new.note: Sirloin carved pink, puffed popovers, horseradish cream and pan gravy, for The Royal Rascal.
new.how: Beef sirloin roasted pink and carved thin, with puffed popovers, crunchy roast potatoes, horseradish cream and a rich pan gravy. Heat the oven to 220C. Parboil 1kg potatoes 8 minutes, rough up and roast in oil 50 minutes. Season a 1.2kg sirloin, sear and roast 30 to 35 minutes for medium rare, then rest 15 minutes. Whisk 140g plain flour, 3 eggs and 200ml milk. Heat 1 tsp oil in each hole of a 12-hole muffin tin until smoking, pour in the batter and bake 20 minutes. Make gravy from the pan juices, 1 tbsp plain flour and 450ml beef stock. Mix 150ml whipped cream with 2 tbsp horseradish.
